reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread to confirm the correction: the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats.

- **Her earlier post still has the old number.** Her #north-team message from this morning still says 261 seats. I suggested she edit it or post a correction there so Dana and Marcus see the right figure. I didn't post anything in #north-team myself, since she said no action was needed.
- **I don't keep notes between conversations.** I told her the only record of the 100 is her thread and that #north-team post.
- **I couldn't check either number.** There are no Quarrendon files in the share, so neither 100 nor 261 can be checked against a contract.

One slip: in my first reply I said her #north-team post still showed the old number before I had actually looked. I then checked, it does say 261, and my second message gives the confirmed figure.
